overview: Offline-first Japanese JLPT N4/N5 learning app with kanji, vocabulary, adaptive quiz, and now Reading practice with smart vocabulary linking.
features: JLPT-format reading practice (posters, schedules, emails, announcements)
Adaptive Weakness Reading targeting user's weak vocabulary
Smart Vocabulary Link — click any word for instant definition from 658-entry database
Reading Analytics tracking score, time, and word lookups
Integration with adaptive quiz, mastery system, and study plan
Offline-first — all content generated client-side with no network dependency
